eventName: Fifth Anniversary ? One Lakh Palm Seeds Planting Festival Second Week Field Activity
eventDescription:
During the second week of the field activity held along the Thiruvangarani lake shore, more than 5,000 palm seeds were planted on both sides of the lake, covering a stretch of approximately one kilometer.
In this event, which is part of the journey toward natural restoration, several organizations made their green contributions and added significance to the occasion?
Exnora International, Mambalam Lions Club, Triveni Academy, Kuzhalosai Organization, Pasumai India Foundation, and the Ambattur Waterbody Protection Group.
